rules.one_occupied_final_starter: one starter-week exposure; all starter slots including FLEX 23, K, DST and original P; bench 20 and IR 21 excluded

rules.source_attribution: latest verified entry into same franchise, with all processed per-period transaction history, original draft and pre-game player lock validation; missing chain => unknown
rules.yield: separate source-conditional starter-worthy rate; exact original-year full player pool and eligibility required
rules.execution: independent final actual quality / best legal attainable starter ceiling; 2026 exists independently of source history
